description: 'Portamical.Core' is the framework-agnostic core of 'Portamical': a universal, identity-driven test data modeling framework for .NET.
releaseNotes:
v4.0.0 (2026-06-26) - Major Architectural Evolution: Standalone Formatting Library & API Refinement

      BREAKING CHANGES:
      1. Formatting Library Extracted
         - NEW: Portamical.Core.Formatting standalone package (auto-included as dependency)
         - IMPACT: Formatting utilities now in separate NuGet package
         - MIGRATION: Update to Portamical.Core v4.0.0 (includes Portamical.Core.Formatting automatically)

      2. Formatter API Refinement
         - RENAMED: ValueFormatter → DefaultFormatter (better clarity)
         - MOVED: IFormatter to Portamical.Core.Formatting.CustomFormatters namespace
         - CHANGED: IFormatter<T>.Format(T) return type: string? → string (non-nullable)
         - NEW: Formatter<T> abstract base class for easier custom formatter implementation
         - MIGRATION: Change 'using static Portamical.Core.Formatting.ValueFormatter;' to 'using static Portamical.Core.Formatting.Builder;'

      3. Formatter Registry API Changes
         - REMOVED: ValueFormatter.Registry, RegisterFormatter, UnregisterFormatter
         - NEW: Formatter static class with simplified registration API
         - MIGRATION: Use Formatter.RegisterFormatter<T>() instead of ValueFormatter.Registry

      NEW FEATURES:
      - Standalone Formatting Library (Portamical.Core.Formatting v1.0.0)
        - Independently versioned formatting infrastructure
        - Builder utilities: FallbackIfNull, JoinWithComma, CreateSeparatedString, CopyAsSpan
        - Singleton pattern: DefaultFormatter.Instance
      - Formatter<T> abstract base class simplifies custom formatter implementation
      - ASCII character caching (5x performance improvement for printable chars 32-126)
      - Comprehensive XML documentation with thread-safety guarantees

      IMPROVEMENTS:
      - Simplified custom formatter API surface
      - Zero-allocation span-based string building
      - Enhanced performance in character formatting hot paths
      - Complete migration guide included in README

      MIGRATION GUIDE:
      Step 1: Update package - dotnet add package Portamical.Core --version 4.0.0
      Step 2: Update namespaces - 'using static Portamical.Core.Formatting.Builder;'
      Step 3: Update formatter calls - DefaultFormatter.Format() instead of ValueFormatter.Format()
      Step 4: Update custom formatters - inherit from Formatter<T> base class

      For full details see: https://github.com/CsabaDu/Portamical/blob/master/Portamical.Core/README.md
